'''Mandalore the Conqueror''' was an individual who took up the title of [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore]], the leader of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior culture,<ref name="Revan" /> sometime between [[7000 BBY]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> and [[3996 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Mandalore oversaw a number of military campaigns that greatly expanded the resources and territory of the Mandalorians, establishing the [[Mandalorian Crusaders]].<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Mandalore the Conqueror was first mentioned in the [[2011]] novel ''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''.<ref name="Revan" />
